name: Intake Foyer & Forfeit Corridor
act: Act I: The Cold Crate at the Customs House
description: Rain needles the zinc roof of the Border Customs House. A trail of blue hoarfrost creeps out from under the iron wicket of the Forfeit Corridor. Hollis the Twice-Written furiously balances his two-column ledger while Factor Vane watches a silicon hourglass.

cast.name: Hollis the Twice-Written
cast.description: Unshaven quartermaster in chainmail under a clerk's coat; left polygon shoulder unmodelled. Obsessed with 1588 bell weights and balancing the ledger.

cast.name: Factor Vane of House Kestrel
cast.description: Porcelain-skinned factor in vacuum-tight obsidian robes with frost clinging to his collar, computing Nash equilibria on a silicon tablet.

cast.name: Pell the Underwritten
cast.description: Earnest young performer clutching a script blank below line one. Taking a grudge bolts the stage door; authoring a named role turns him into your boldest companion.

cast.name: Surveyor-Senior Vellum
cast.description: Ink-stained field auditor in a waxed greatcoat with a brass astrolabe that spins wildly near unrendered ground.

primitives.name: Hollis's Quartermaster Ledger Desk
primitives.description: Scaffolded oak counter grooved from thousands of brass tallies. Holds the master customs manifest, red sealing wax, and ink horn.

primitives.name: Crate #00-NULL / Glass Stasis Coffin
primitives.description: Smuggled inside coarse Baltic pine slats, chilling the flagstones to absolute zero. Triggers a live Cross-Domain Coherence conflict until curated.

primitives.name: Declared R6-SHIP Salted Turnip Bounding Box
primitives.description: Standardised container used as fraudulent diplomatic cover. Everything downstream (rate, seal, clearance) is arithmetic on the box.

primitives.name: Sealed Customs Forfeit Locker
primitives.description: Reinforced iron-banded locker where Hollis impounds unregistered cargo under statute 1588.
